decisions.name: 林慶台
decisions.sourceRightsEvidence: Commons uploader P1340 claims own work and CC BY-SA 3.0; cropping is permitted subject to attribution and share-alike.
decisions.visualEvidence: Commons 500x667 actual image preview opened and inspected 2026-11-01; center foreground man is the subject identified in the caption, with other people at left/right and behind. Face is three-quarter and dim/noisy; original full pixels and 600x720 reveal stages not independently inspected in this run.
decisions.nextAction: Manually crop central foreground man's face from the 3240x4320 original, exclude all other faces, inspect full 600x720 and five reveals for eye/nose/mouth/chin visibility, sharpness, and identity; verify derivative attribution/share-alike before any release.

decisions.visualEvidence: Actual 960x640 Commons thumbnail viewed 2026-11-01: subject at center-left of a wide stage, with a second prominent performer at right, foreground audience and handheld microphone. Face occupies a small fraction of the frame; nighttime stage image not suitable for a sharp, isolated five-stage quiz portrait.
decisions.nextAction: Do not use this exact photo for the game despite reviewed CC license; keep searching other independently licensed close portraits.
